description: record step-level execution state and produced artifacts in an existing Work Breakdown Structure without rewriting the whole document.
embedding_description: Record step state in work breakdown structure. Update a single WBS step with generated filenames, completion status, checkpoint outcomes, or phase handoff state. Narrow mutation that preserves the rest of the document.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Recording execution state for a WBS step. record_work_breakdown_structure_step_state accepts {wbs_id, step_number, status, state_summary?, output_artifacts?}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. NotFoundError: WBS with this ID does not exist.
